subject: Logic
title: The Barber Paradox
description: A 60-second lesson on The Barber Paradox.

hook.text: A town barber shaves everyone who doesn't shave themselves. Who shaves the barber?

buildup.text: If the barber shaves himself, he's someone who shaves himself—so he shouldn't. If he doesn't, he should.

discovery.text: Russell used this as an everyday version of his set paradox. Same structure, friendlier packaging.

twist.text: The real solution: no such barber can exist. The description is self-contradictory from the start.

climax.text: Some definitions are impossible. Not every description picks out something that can actually exist.
